workouts.title: Overhead Squat
workouts.description:
Overhead Squat
3x5 @ @32X1
Rest 2:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- "32x1" means that you will take :03 to descend, :02 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.

workouts.title: Snatch Complex 5x1
workouts.description:
5x1.1 @
Rest :10 between reps.
Rest 2:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- The "1.1" snatch prescription means that you should perform one snatch, rest :10, then perform another snatch.
- These should be full snatch reps (i.e. squat snatch) for every rep.
